root.name: ラマー・アドバタイジング

relations.text: 出資していた広告技術のVistar MediaをT-Mobileが買収し、持ち分20%を約1.16億ドルで売却(2025年2月)
relations.text_en: T-Mobile bought Vistar Media, in which Lamar held 20%; Lamar received about $116 million (February 2025)

source.label: Lamar Advertising 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 3, 2025, T-Mobile USA, Inc. acquired 100 % of Vistar (the "Sale"). In connection with the closing of the Sale, the Company received $ 115,881 in cash consideration for the sale of its 20 % equity interest in Vistar.

relations.text: 経営陣のReilly家が保有する会社の傘下の通信会社。データ保全サービスを買い、広告を売る
relations.text_en: Telecom owned via a Reilly family company: Lamar buys data backup services from it and sells it advertising

source.label: Lamar Advertising 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: During the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company was a customer of EATEL for data back-up and recovery services.

companies.name: クリア・チャンネル・アウトドア

relations.text: 互いに10-Kで大手の競合として名指し
relations.text_en: Each names the other as a large competitor in its 10-K

source.label: Clear Channel Outdoor 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: OOH advertising industry is fragmented and highly competitive, consisting of other large operators such as Lamar Advertising Company and Outfront Media Inc., as well as numerous regional and local participants.

relations.text: 10-Kで、より大きな屋外広告会社の一社として名指し
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a larger outdoor advertising provider

source.label: Lamar Advertising 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Larger outdoor advertising providers, such as (i) Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings, Inc., which operates billboards, street furniture displays, transit displays and other out-of-home advertising displays and (ii) Outfront Media, Inc., which operates traditional outdoor, street furniture and transit advertising properties.

companies.name: アウトフロント・メディア

relations.text: 10-Kで、より大きな屋外広告会社の一社として名指し
relations.text_en: Named in its 10-K as a larger outdoor advertising provider

source.label: Lamar Advertising 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Larger outdoor advertising providers, such as (i) Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings, Inc., which operates billboards, street furniture displays, transit displays and other out-of-home advertising displays and (ii) Outfront Media, Inc., which operates traditional outdoor, street furniture and transit advertising properties.

relations.text: OUTFRONTも10-Kで、全国規模の屋外広告会社としてLamarを挙げる
relations.text_en: OUTFRONT also names Lamar as a national outdoor advertising company

source.label: OUTFRONT Media 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The outdoor advertising industry is fragmented, consisting of a few companies operating on a national basis, such as our company, Lamar, Clear Channel Outdoor, JCDecaux and Intersection

companies.name: ボストン・オマハ
companies.sub: 看板広告・ブロードバンド

relations.text: Boston Omahaが10-Kで、看板の大半を持つ大手3社の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Boston Omaha names it among the three companies that own most US billboards

source.label: Boston Omaha 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The outdoor advertising industry in the United States consists of several large companies, and three companies, Clear Channel Outdoor, Outfront Media and Lamar Advertising Company, own a majority of all outdoor billboards.
